quotes.text: Customers have up to 180 calendar days to file a dispute from the date of capture.
Fraudulent transactions are one example of this immediate escalation, but there are also other scenarios.

Refunding during the inquiry dispute period avoids a dispute fee and prevents the inquiry from being escalated to a chargeback dispute. Refunds can no longer be performed after the inquiry escalates to a chargeback dispute.
Businesses have 12 calendar days from chargeback escalation to provide evidence, except for fraud disputes, which have a 5 day timeframe.
You can submit evidence on the dispute, but you can’t simulate the final dispute outcome in a sandbox.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/klarna/disputes, a Klarna customer files an order complaint or return request in the Klarna app within 180 calendar days of capture, subject to listed exceptions. Most cases enter a 21-day inquiry. Customer withdrawal or a refund matching the full disputed amount can resolve it without a dispute fee; only an unresolved inquiry automatically escalates after 21 days, when Stripe withholds disputed funds and the associated fee. Evidence is then accepted, with a 12-day deadline or five days for fraud (old raw lines 40-89; new raw lines 62-111). The comparison table says fees are assessed when a dispute is created, but its fee timing must be scoped to the chargeback stage beside the inquiry prose (old raw line 31; new raw line 54). API statuses distinguish inquiry from chargeback and won/lost states; sandbox triggers cannot simulate final outcomes (old raw lines 271-273, 553-595; new raw lines 245-247, 527-569). source-stripe-klarna-disputes.md summarizes most mechanics but lines 20-23 need this inquiry and fee-stage qualification, alongside newer provenance and narrower wording about fraud and seven test scenarios.

The added diagram, normalized tables, changed sandbox wording and Node-to-cURL examples are presentation changes; linked policies and API pages are navigation, not read authority. Correct its lines 20-23: only unresolved inquiries escalate, withdrawal or full-disputed-amount refund avoids the fee, and withholding begins at chargeback escalation (old raw lines 40-48, 72-81; new raw lines 62-70, 94-103). Warn reciprocally that the raw table's 'fee on creation' wording (old raw line 31; new raw line 54) is ambiguous beside that prose; do not imply inquiry-opening fee assessment. The comparison table's nonfraud inquiry claim also has other direct-chargeback exceptions in detailed prose. Keep secret-key API calls server-side, distinguish Dashboard from API state and webhook timing, and never infer a final dispute result from evidence submission or sandbox simulation.
